value.rationale: A sharp complete first-obstruction threshold within connected cacti is a motivated finite-model-theoretic invariant of a natural sparse hereditary block class. The exact number and two different types of first failure contribute substantially more than isolated small examples, distinguishing class-relative graph identification from the well-known different orbit-refinement problem.
